settings.text:
Eight pieces chosen to sit together, packed by hand in our Melbourne studio and finished with a printed card in your own words. Mulberry silk for the eye mask, pillowcase and scrunchie, cut from the same run so the colour matches. Then bed socks, a pillow mist, a herbal tea, a small candle and a journal for the bedside table.

It arrives tied, in a rigid box worth keeping, with no invoice inside and no pricing on the outside. Send it straight to them.

settings.a1_body:
• Mulberry silk eye mask. 22 momme, grade 6A silk, covered elastic strap.
  • Silk pillowcase. Standard 48 by 74 cm, same 22 momme silk, hidden zip.
  • Matching silk scrunchie. Cut from the offcuts of the pillowcase run, so the colour is an exact match.
  • Bed socks. Fine knit, ribbed cuff, sized to fit AU 5 to 10.
  • Pillow mist. 100 ml, alcohol free, in recycled glass with a fine atomiser.
  • Herbal wind down tea. Loose leaf, 30 g, caffeine free, in a tin that outlives the box.
  • Small candle. Poured wax, cotton wick, around 20 hours of burn time.
  • Sleep journal. 96 unlined pages, sewn flat so it stays open on a bedside table.

settings.heading: Eight pieces, one ritual
settings.body: Every item had to earn its place next to the other seven. The silk is cut from one run so the mask, pillowcase and scrunchie match exactly. The candle is small on purpose, because there is already a scent in the box.

settings.text: Rigid box, wrapped in uncoated paper, sturdy enough to be used for something else afterwards.
Printed sleeve, tissue and a ribbon tied by hand. Choose the ribbon at checkout.
No invoice inside and no pricing anywhere on the outside, so it can go straight to them.

settings.heading: A box worth keeping
settings.body:
The packaging is part of the gift rather than something to get through. A rigid keepsake box under a printed sleeve, tissue folded back over the contents, and a ribbon tied on the bench before the lid goes on.

Your message is written on a printed card and sits on top, so it is the first thing they read.
settings.image_alt: The open box with the lid propped behind it, tissue folded back over the contents

settings.quote: We wanted to send something better than a candle with a bow on it
settings.body: Sleep Shop is a small studio in Melbourne making one thing properly. Making one box means we get to be particular about all eight pieces in it, and to know exactly where each one comes from.
